scope.purpose: diagnose scaling wall and validate lot-1 nnz semantics without solver optimization

measurement_semantics.free_dofs: total DOF minus fixed indices from the actual model
measurement_semantics.nnz: global assembled stiffness CSR final_nnz before constraint reduction
measurement_semantics.reduced_stiffness_nnz: reduced CSR nnz after fixed/MPC constraint elimination
measurement_semantics.total_seconds: existing route execution total_seconds; wall_total also includes model construction
measurement_semantics.peak_rss: parent psutil sampler around an isolated child containing warmup and measured repetitions; null if unavailable
measurement_semantics.timing_overhead_control: performance timings run without the RSS sampler and tracemalloc; memory is measured in the parent and tracemalloc is used only in separate lot-1 evidence
measurement_semantics.matrix_storage: CSR data + indices + indptr nbytes for global stiffness

cases: largest completed TET4 case near 10000 DOF

scaling.repetitions: one measured run per expensive intermediate size; Lot-1 repetition evidence remains separate
scaling.lot_1_intrusive_timeout: HARNESS_ERROR when RSS/tracemalloc are active during timed execution; Lot-2 timing separates performance and memory measurement

memory.copy_audit: Use phase diagnostics and cProfile; do not infer an unmeasured copy as a bottleneck

high_order.comparison: same unit tetrahedron or unit cube, same isotropic material, same all-fixed-except-node-1-UX boundary convention
high_order.interpretation: implementation/resource comparison only; not equal-accuracy or mesh-convergence evidence

numeric_policy.numerical_regression_detected: YES only if checksum/residual/status changes are observed against the same case; otherwise NO
